mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary easing by the Fed, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a strong labor market recovery coupled with accommodative monetary policy, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and FEDFUNDS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-pandemic recovery (defined by UNRATE falling >2.0pp from its 3-month high), rising housing starts (HOUST) signal a rebound in consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises and UNRATE falls >2.0pp from 3-month high, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output and supply chain activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals strong demand without inflationary pressure, which is favorable for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and decline in CPIAUCSL fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals active monetary easing, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
